cases.refreshed: Every now and then, libraries need a little extra love from the communities they serve. You can volunteer away your library fines at a rate of $20 per hour while helping the library maintain a clean and welcoming environment. Volunteers will be responsible for: Book cover cleaning – Use disinfecting wipes to reinvigorate dingy books. Bookshelves – Dust shelves and organize library materials. Deep cleaning computers – Use disinfecting wipes to disinfect computer mice and mouse pads and compressed air to remove any dust particles or debris. Material inspection – Check books for torn pages, pen marks, etc. This is a perfect opportunity for anyone interested in volunteering away their library fines. Volunteers must commit to the full session. Anyone under 15 must volunteer with a parent or guardian. No experience or special skills are needed. Training and supplies will be provided. Space is limited.

events.title: Book Bugs Club for 2nd and 3rd Graders

cases.refreshed: Are you a second or third grader? Do you like to read books and talk about them with other kids? Then The Book Bugs Club is for you! Our December book selection is The Storm by Cynthia Rylant. At our book club meeting, we will discuss the book and enjoy a fun craft or activity. Please pick up a copy of the book at the Children's Desk at Los Altos Library or at Woodland Library to check out. Please read the book at home before our meeting. Space is limited. This event will take place in the Los Altos Library Orchard Room. Many thanks to the Friends of the Los Altos Library for making this program possible. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
